title: עין בוקק (En Boqeq, first season)
author: M. Gichon
location_note: En Boqeq: the Roman-Byzantine fort and the Hasmonean-Herodian farm; no map reference. INFERENCE: southern edge of the Z3 box.
notes: Fort about 19.5 x 19.5 m founded by the mid-4th century CE, renovated in the 6th; about 250 coins; scroll fragments in Greek and Arabic(?) in a tower (not eligible). Farm about 20 x 15 m of ashlars.

features.subtype: large plastered room or pool in the farm building (excavator unsure), beside an entrance room with plastered benches
features.period: farm flourished from Alexander Jannaeus to the First Revolt
features.quote: וחדר או בריכה גדולה טוחה

features.subtype: male burial in the farm ruins with two Herodian coins on the eyes
features.period: after the farm's destruction (Herodian coins); not dated further
features.quote: קבורת גבר בתוך חורבות הבניין

title: ירושלים: המצודה (Jerusalem, the Citadel)
author: R. Amiran and A. Eitan
location_note: Citadel courtyard, inside the line of the Second Temple period wall; no map reference.
notes: Stratum III Herodian building against the wall (89 coins, all before the First Revolt); stratum IV earlier building. The stratum I channels were exposed and dated to the Roman period by C. N. Johns (earlier work).

features.subtype: floor with three water channels (stratum I) and a floor with one water channel (stratum II)
features.period: stratum I Roman (Johns); stratum II not yet dated
features.quote: רצפה עם שלוש תעלות מים

title: ירושלים: הרובע היהודי (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter checks 1968)
author: A. Ovadiah and E. Menczel
location_note: Karaite synagogue; Crusader church of St Mary of the Germans; Batei Mahse and Rothschild house courtyard; Misgav Ladach hospital; no map references.
notes: Crusader church and monastery halls, a Crusader street (not eligible). The pool is compared by the authors to the Struthion pool. The author names are partly garbled in the text layer.

features.subtype: large pool 22 x 7 m, about 15 m deep, rock-cut below and built above, vaulted roof on three rock pillars, air shafts
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: זוהי בריכה גדולה למדי חצובה בחלקה התחתון ובנוייה בחלקה העליון

features.subtype: underground structure below the apses used by the residents as a cistern; not examined
features.period: not dated
features.quote: ששימש את דיירי המקום כבור מים

features.subtype: rectangular built and plastered vaulted cistern 10 x 4 m, 6 m deep, cross in the plaster
features.period: probably Crusader (masonry and vault)
features.quote: מתחת לחורבותיו של בית החולים נתגלה בור מים

title: ירושלים: מערות קברים (Jerusalem, tomb caves: Giv'at ha-Mivtar, police school, Ben Zvi Boulevard)
author: S. Gudovitch
location_note: Giv'at ha-Mivtar; road by the police school; Ben Zvi Boulevard; no map references.
notes: One kokhim cave robbed (Giv'at ha-Mivtar); one with 18 ossuaries, mostly decorated, one inscribed, Herodian lamps (police school); three robbed kokhim caves with three ossuaries (Ben Zvi Boulevard).

features.subtype: kokhim tomb caves with ossuaries
features.period: end of the Second Temple period
features.quote: נתגלו בירושלים מערות קברים נוספות מסוף ימי הבית השני

title: בית מלאכה מימי הבית השני בסביבות ירושלים (Second Temple period workshop near Jerusalem, Jebel Mukabbir)
author: (Department of Antiquities; K. Cooper)
location_note: Jebel Mukabbir, south-east of Jerusalem (by Beit Hanina children's home); no map reference.
notes: Waste of stone measuring cups dumped into the quarry cave; the workshop stood above it.

features.subtype: underground quarry with stone-vessel workshop waste (cores of measuring cups); perhaps ossuary stones cut there
features.period: end of the Second Temple period (stone measuring cups)
features.quote: התברר שמדובר במחצבה קרקעית תת

title: צובה (Zova)
author: S. Ben-Arieh
location_note: Kibbutz Zova; no map reference.

features.subtype: three tombs related to stone heaps, several skeletons each
features.period: Middle Bronze II B
features.quote: נחפרו במקום שלושה קברים מתקופת הברונזה התיכונה

title: הרודיון (Herodium, 1969 conservation and clearing)
author: G. Foerster
location_note: Herodium, upper palace; no map reference.
notes: Exedra and palace gate with frescoes; gate destroyed by fire; about 30 ostraca; an inkwell like those of Qumran. An entrance tunnel built in the fill (not eligible).

features.subtype: hoard of coins of year four of the First Revolt in the burnt debris of the gate
features.period: year 4 of the First Revolt (69/70 CE)
features.quote: מטמון מטבעות משנת ארבע למרד הראשון

features.subtype: miqveh adjoining the synagogue facade (excavator: miqveh, like those of Masada)
features.period: First Revolt phase (synagogue benches added then)
features.quote: שהמקווה הצמוד אל חזיתו דומה מאוד למקוואות שנחשפו במצדה

features.subtype: system of large rock-cut cisterns with waterproof plaster inside the hill, reached by rock-cut passages and steep steps from the palace
features.period: Herodian (linked by the report to Herod's water supply in Josephus)
features.quote: נתגלתה מערכת בורות מים גדולים חצובים בסלע וטוחים

features.subtype: plastered vaulted channels about 3 m high leading to the cisterns, opening half-way up the hill
features.period: Herodian (as the cisterns)
features.quote: נמצאו תעלות טוחות ומקומרות שגובהן 3 מ

title: בדיקות באתרים בין עין פשחה לעין גדי (sites between Ein Feshkha and En Gedi: Ein el-Ghuweir)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: Dead Sea shore between Ein el-Ghuweir and Ein et-Turaba, about 15 km south of Qumran; no map reference. Not a held area (south of Ein Feshkha; built site and cemetery).
notes: Large building 45 x 20 m with hall and two rooms, burnt layer with coins of Herod, Archelaus and Agrippa I (37 BCE-46 CE), stone measuring vessel, Herodian lamp; interpreted as an Essene centre (CLAIM). Iron Age building and a 600 m wall with about 20 rooms (not eligible). The author also asserts that Kh. Qumran should be identified with Secacah 'according to the Copper Scroll' (CLAIM; noted only).

features.subtype: cemetery 600 m north of the building: 20 shaft graves (1.5-2 m deep) with a side loculus, covered with stones, like those of Qumran
features.period: same as the building (coins 37 BCE-46 CE); a jar inscribed 'Yehohanan' in a script like the scrolls
features.quote: באופיים ובחציבתם זהים קברים אלה לקברים שנחפרו

title: בית חורון תחתון (Lower Beth Horon)
author: Z. Kallai (students' survey)
location_note: Lower Beth Horon (Beit Ur et-Tahta); no map reference. Zone by the title's gazetteer name; INFERENCE: the village lies just west of the Z4 box.
notes: A movable stone dyeing installation found in a courtyard and taken to the Rockefeller building. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: גבעון (Gibeon, site improvements)
author: (Staff officer for archaeology, military government)
screen_note: Gibeon (el-Jib) is not in the gazetteer; it lies inside the Z4 box (exploratory by-eye match).
location_note: Gibeon (el-Jib); no map reference.
notes: Paths and steps to the pool, the tunnel entrance and the spring; stone walls around the pool strengthened. The features are those excavated by J. B. Pritchard (earlier work); none is dated in this note.

features.subtype: the Gibeon pool, surrounding walls strengthened
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: הורחב השביל המוליך לבריכה

features.subtype: water tunnel to the spring (entrance path improved)
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: נסלל שביל נוח מהבריכה אל פתח המנהרה

title: ח' רדנה (Kh. Radana)
author: J. A. Callaway
screen_note: Not in the gazetteer by its own name; the text places it by the police offices in Ramallah, and Ramallah is a Z4 gazetteer name. INFERENCE: the site lies at about the northern edge of the Z4 box.
location_note: By the police offices in Ramallah; no map reference.
notes: Iron Age I house; fragments of a multi-handled offering bowl with a tube and two animal heads; jar handle incised with letters (end of the 11th century BCE). No feature of the eligible classes.

title: שכם (Shechem, Roman tomb)
author: (inspector Ibrahim el-Fani)
location_note: Nablus (municipal works); no map reference.

features.subtype: rock-cut chamber 3 x 3 m closed by a stone door, two graves cut in the floor; Roman pottery in the pit by the entrance
features.period: Roman
features.quote: גילו עובדי העירייה קבר רומי הסגור בדלת אבן

title: ירושלים: הרובע היהודי (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter sounding by St Mary of the Germans)
author: I. Margovsky
location_note: By the Crusader church of St Mary of the Germans; no map reference.
notes: Eight strata; buildings of the end of the 2nd and the 1st century BCE (not eligible); Herodian stratum badly destroyed.

features.subtype: drainage under the paving and stone steps of stratum 4
features.period: Roman (3rd-4th centuries CE, probably Aelia Capitolina)
features.quote: בה נשתמר ריצוף ומדרגות אבן והתיעול שמתחתיו

title: ירושלים: שרידי מצד ליד הגבעה הצרפתית (Jerusalem, fort remains by French Hill)
author: O. Negbi
location_note: Foot of French Hill, north-east Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Podium of a fort 21 x 17 m, late Iron Age or early Persian pottery, a Yehud coin. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים: שיפוץ מצבות נחל קדרון (Jerusalem, renovation of the Kidron valley monuments)
author: E. Oren (supervision)
location_note: Kidron valley: Absalom's Pillar, Tomb of Jehoshaphat, Tomb of Zechariah; no map reference.
notes: Fresco remains in the Tomb of Jehoshaphat (a Christian chapel in the Middle Ages). The original courtyard of the Jehoshaphat tomb extended west under the road; a cistern west of the road may have belonged to it (excavators' suggestion, not coded separately). The 1960 finds at Zechariah's tomb (square niche, steps, plastered cistern) are earlier work; the arched structures and cistern removed now are not earlier than the Mamluk period. Finds from Roman (Herodian lamp) to Early Arab.

features.subtype: funerary monuments cleaned: Absalom's Pillar, the rock-cut Tomb of Jehoshaphat, the Tomb of Zechariah (unfinished cutting)
features.period: not dated in the report (Zechariah later than Bene Hezir)
features.quote: הוחל בניקוי מצבת יד אבשלום וסביבתה וכן קבר יהושפט

features.subtype: later vaulted structure and cistern at the south-east corner of Absalom's Pillar, demolished; cistern and arched structures at Zechariah's tomb removed
features.period: later additions; the structures at Zechariah not earlier than the Mamluk period
features.quote: הוחל בהריסת המבנה המקומר ובור המים שנוספו בתקופה מאוחרת

features.subtype: deep wide channels cut in the rock when the base of Zechariah's monument was prepared; cutting abandoned
features.period: not dated
features.quote: ובו תעלות עמוקות ורחבות שנחצבו בעת הכנת אדן המצבה

title: סקר אמות המים הקדומות לירושלים ולהרודיון (survey of the ancient aqueducts to Jerusalem and Herodium)
author: Y. Cohen and A. Mazar (Kfar Etzion field school)
location_note: Solomon's Pools, Wadi Arrub, Wadi Biyar, Bethlehem, Jebel Mukabbir, Emeq Refaim, Artas to Herodium; no map references. INFERENCE: the Arrub sources lie on the southern edge of Z4; the rest inside Z4.
notes: Arrub aqueduct 41 km from Ein Kuweiziba to the middle pool, with tunnels and two guard towers; Wadi Biyar tunnel 2.5 km with dozens of shafts up to 25 m deep (compared to Roman-period qanats); an underground ashlar room with a barrel vault typical of the Roman period (function unknown); lower aqueduct tunnels under Bethlehem and Jebel Mukabbir (about 400 m); upper aqueduct with stone-pipe segments in the Rachel's Tomb valley (over 2 km) and on the east edge of Emeq Refaim; tunnels of Ein Saleh, Ein Burak and Ein Farujeh; Herodium aqueduct from Ein Artas. None dated by the report except by comparison.

features.subtype: aqueducts to Jerusalem and Herodium: Arrub, Wadi Biyar tunnel, lower and upper aqueducts, Herodium aqueduct, spring tunnels by Solomon's Pools
features.period: not dated by the report (Wadi Biyar tunnel compared to Roman-period qanats)
features.quote: האמה המפותלת והארוכה ביותר היא זו המובילה מעין

features.subtype: solid dams carrying the Arrub aqueduct across several streams
features.period: not dated
features.quote: אמה זו חוצה מספר נחלים על גבי סכרים איתנים

features.subtype: Arrub pool, Solomon's Pools installations, and the square pool at the foot of Herodium
features.period: not dated
features.quote: נראה כי האמה הובילה לבריכה המרובעת שלמרגלות המבצר

title: הסקר הארכיאולוגי ביהודה (archaeological survey in Judea, Bethlehem to Hebron)
author: S. Guttman
location_note: From Bethlehem to the Hebron area and the Hebron-Bet Guvrin road; the in-region part is Bethlehem. No map references.
notes: General observations on Mishnah-Talmud period villages (caves under houses with cisterns, oil presses, winepresses, cupmarks, dyeing installations) not tied to sites; unlocated, not coded. In Bethlehem: Iron II pottery south of the Church of the Nativity (no feature).

title: ירושלים: הרובע היהודי (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter 1969, site A)
author: N. Avigad (director)
location_note: Jewish Quarter of the Old City, opposite the Temple Mount; no map reference.
notes: Nine settlement phases from the end of the Iron Age to the Crusader period; 7th-century BCE settlement; Hasmonean public buildings; fresco fragments and Ionic capitals attributed to a palace of the 1st century BCE (coins of Alexander Jannaeus and Herod). The report's term is 'מקווי מים'; coded ritual_bath (INFERENCE: miqvaot in Avigad's usage).

features.subtype: 'מקווי מים' (miqvaot) found with the public buildings of the Hasmonean stratum
features.period: in the paragraph on the stratum of the Hasmonean period (1st-2nd centuries BCE)
features.quote: נתגלו גם מקווי מים ומערכת תעלות

features.subtype: system of channels found with the Hasmonean public buildings
features.period: in the paragraph on the stratum of the Hasmonean period (1st-2nd centuries BCE)
features.quote: נתגלו גם מקווי מים ומערכת תעלות

title: ירושלים: המצודה - 1969 (Jerusalem, the Citadel, 1969)
author: R. Amiran and A. Eitan
location_note: Citadel by the Jaffa Gate; no map reference.
notes: Second season: Herodian podium buildings and wall, Hellenistic wall and tower, Iron Age fill. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים: הר הצופים (Jerusalem, Mount Scopus, Jewish family tomb)
author: E. Oren
location_note: Near Lord Grey's house on Mount Scopus; no map reference.
notes: Rock-cut courtyard, kokhim room, bone-collecting room with an ashlar wall, ossuary storage room; built central pit; four decorated ossuaries.

features.subtype: family tomb with rock-cut courtyard, kokhim room, ossuary rooms; burial began probably in a natural cave
features.period: burial began early 1st century BCE, end of the Hasmonean period (lamps and pottery)
features.quote: נחשפה אחוזת קבר משפחתית שכללה חצר חצובה בסלע

title: ביהודה ושומרון: הורקניה (Judea and Samaria: Hyrcania, aqueduct survey)
author: Y. Feldman (staff officer for archaeology, military government)
screen_note: Sub-item of the composite 'ביהודה ושומרון'; Hyrcania in the gazetteer.
location_note: Hyrcania (Kh. el-Mird); no map reference.
notes: One sentence: a survey of the Hyrcania aqueduct was made. No description or date.

features.subtype: aqueduct of Hyrcania (surveyed; not described)
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: סקר אמת המים בהורקניה

title: בית הכנסת בנערן (the synagogue at Naaran)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: Ein Duk (Naaran); no map reference.
notes: Mosaic re-exposed; zodiac inscriptions; conservation. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: פעולות שימור: המצד הרומי בגבעת שאול (conservation: the Roman fort at Giv'at Shaul)
author: (Department of Antiquities)
screen_note: Sub-item of the conservation item; Jerusalem fort excavated in 1967 (HA 24).
location_note: Giv'at Shaul, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Fort reinforced and set in the garden of the Ezrat Nashim institution. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ביהודה ושומרון: בית סחור (Judea and Samaria: Beit Sahur, tomb cave)
author: (staff officer for archaeology team)
screen_note: Sub-item of the composite 'ביהודה ושומרון' (by-eye: Beit Sahur is not in the gazetteer; inside the Z4 box).
location_note: Beit Sahur, east of Bethlehem; no map reference.

features.subtype: tomb cave broken in through the ceiling; original opening faces west
features.period: Middle Canaanite (MB) II, phase B (two jars, three jugs)
features.quote: הפתח המקורי של המערה פונה מערבה

title: ביהודה ושומרון: נערן (Judea and Samaria: Naaran, synagogue conservation)
author: R. Vidal (Department conservator)
location_note: Naaran (Ein Duk); no map reference.
notes: Mosaic cleaning and consolidation; retaining wall round the hill. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים: הרובע היהודי (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter, sites B-E)
author: N. Avigad (director)
location_note: Jewish Quarter; site B 170 m west of the Temple Mount opposite Robinson's Arch; site E by the Nisan Bek synagogue ruins; no map references.
notes: Site B: the Burnt House, destroyed in 70 CE (coins of the First Revolt); Iron Age wall of the 7th century BCE. Sites C-E: Hasmonean column base, Herodian Corinthian capital, Herodian mansion (site E) destroyed after Herod and not rebuilt; Byzantine bathhouse with hypocausts and a church (not eligible). The report's term for the pools is 'מקווה מים'; coded ritual_bath (INFERENCE: miqveh in Avigad's usage).

features.subtype: three 'מקווי מים' (miqvaot)
features.period: assigned to the stages of the Herodian period
features.quote: שלושה מקווי מים ותעלת ניקוז בנוייה ומקורה

features.subtype: built, roofed drainage channel as high as a man
features.period: assigned to the stages of the Herodian period
features.quote: שלושה מקווי מים ותעלת ניקוז בנוייה ומקורה

features.subtype: 'מקווה מים' (miqveh) in the house
features.period: house of the days of Herod, destroyed after his reign
features.quote: מקווה מים ושני בורות לאגירת מים

features.subtype: two water-storage cisterns in the house
features.period: house of the days of Herod, destroyed after his reign
features.quote: מקווה מים ושני בורות לאגירת מים

title: ביהודה ושומרון: ח' רדנה (Judea and Samaria: Kh. Radana)
author: J. A. Callaway
screen_note: Sub-item of the composite 'ביהודה ושומרון'. Zone by the Ramallah location given in HA 31-32 and HA 43 (gazetteer name Ramallah).
location_note: Kh. Radana (Ramallah); no map reference.
notes: Salvage excavation resumed; an Iron Age I building. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים: קברים מימי בית שני (Jerusalem, tombs of the Second Temple period)
author: D. Bahat; V. Tzaferis; S. Ben-Arieh; D. N. Freedman and K. Grieser (Albright Institute)
location_note: Giv'at ha-Mivtar; east slope of Mount Scopus; Giv'at Ram (Hebrew University); Isawiya (Ras el-Jami'a), north of Mount Scopus; no map references.
notes: Four tomb groups found during development works. Giv'at ha-Mivtar: second cave with a built barrel vault and a coin of year 2 of the revolt. Isawiya: dressed building stones and plaster in the courtyard, probably from a structure over the tomb; a coin from a ceiling crack does not date the tomb.

features.subtype: two burial caves with kokhim, central pit, decorated ossuaries; one with a built barrel-vaulted ceiling
features.period: end of the Second Temple period; coin of year 2 of the revolt in the second cave
features.quote: שתי מערות קברים מסוף ימי בית שני

features.subtype: rock-cut courtyard with two burial caves; central hall and three 2 x 2 m chambers; ossuaries, one with a Greek inscription
features.period: end of the Hasmonean period and the time of Herod (pottery and glass)
features.quote: שייכת מערת קבורה זו לסוף התקופה החשמונאית ולתקופת הורדום

features.subtype: chamber with bench, pit and five kokhim; two decorated ossuaries
features.period: end of the Second Temple period
features.quote: שייכת המערה לסוף ימי הבית השני

features.subtype: upper and lower tombs with rock-cut courtyard 2.25 x 1.75 m, kokhim, three sealed burial pits, six ossuaries
features.period: Herodian pottery of the second half of the 1st century BCE; whole system of this period
features.quote: ונראה שהמערכת כולה מתקופה זו

features.subtype: segment of a channel (one word unreadable in the text layer) in situ in the courtyard; structure used for drainage
features.period: with the tomb system (Herodian)
features.quote: שהמבנה שימש לניקוז מים

title: ירושלים: הגבעה הצרפתית (Jerusalem, French Hill)
author: E. Oren (with C. Clamer)
location_note: French Hill, north-east Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Massive (fortified?) building of about one dunam with storerooms; Roman column and arch fragments reused.

features.subtype: elaborate oil press (בית בד) with crushing, pressing and storage installations, in the north part of the building
features.period: building in use in the Byzantine-Roman period, 4th-5th centuries CE
features.quote: להפקת שמן ובו מתקני כתישה סחיטה ואגירה

title: ירושלים: מסעף כביש רופין - שדרות בן צבי (Jerusalem, Ruppin road - Ben Zvi boulevard junction)
author: E. Oren (supervision)
location_note: East of the Ruppin road - Ben Zvi boulevard junction (Wolfson buildings); no map reference.
notes: Square guard tower 8 x 8 m with Mamluk glazed pottery, in use in the early Ottoman period (coins).

features.subtype: bell-shaped cistern 7 m north of the tower entrance, cleaned
features.period: not dated; beside a tower of the Mamluk-early Ottoman period
features.quote: נוקה בור מים דמוי פעמון

title: בית כנסת עתיק בעין-גדי (ancient synagogue at En Gedi)
author: Y. Porath and D. Barag
location_note: En Gedi oasis (area of the 1966 mosaic find); no map reference.
notes: Byzantine synagogue 13.65 x 11.80 m, mosaic floor with four inscriptions, niche with a seven-branched bronze menorah and burnt scrolls; destroyed by fire, probably early 7th century CE.

features.subtype: several thousand coins and a bronze cup in the niche (the report does not call it a hoard; class INFERENCE)
features.period: coins of the 4th-6th centuries CE
features.quote: בתוך הגומחה נמצאו כמה אלפי מטבעות

title: עין סמיה (Ein Samiya, cemetery)
author: (Ramallah district inspector for the staff officer for archaeology; name garbled in the text layer)
location_note: Extensive cemetery on the banks of Nahal Auja, not far from Kafr Malik; tied by the report to Kh. Marjama and Kh. Samiya and the spring of Ein Samiya. No map reference.
notes: About 20 tombs excavated so far, four of the Roman period and the rest Middle Bronze I-II shaft tombs. Continues HA 27 (HA27-019).

features.subtype: shaft tombs, round shaft 5-6 m deep, burial caves up to 6 x 8 m
features.period: Middle Bronze Age (Middle Canaanite) phases A and B
features.quote: הקברים הקדומים הינם קברי פיר

features.subtype: kokhim tomb and tomb with arcosolia and burial troughs, cut among the earlier tombs; lamps, gold earrings, glass
features.period: Roman period (finds of the Roman and Byzantine periods)
features.quote: מהם ארבעה קברים מהתקופה הרומית

title: ח' רדנה - 1970 (Kh. Radana, 1970)
author: J. A. Callaway (with D. L. Newlands and W. W. Ellinger)
screen_note: Zone by the Ramallah location given in HA 31-32 and HA 43 (gazetteer name Ramallah).
location_note: Kh. Radana (Ramallah); no map reference.
notes: Large stone heap with a Byzantine retaining wall and rough steps (lookout); Iron I and Byzantine sherds in the fill; Iron Age I pillared building 5 x 10 m with hearth; steatite seal. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים: הרובע היהודי (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter, area A)
author: N. Avigad
location_note: Jewish Quarter, area A; no map reference.
notes: Massive stone wall 7 m wide (the 'broad wall', about 7th century BCE). No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים: בדיקות ליד חומת העיר העתיקה (Jerusalem, test trenches by the Old City wall)
author: R. Amiran and A. Eitan
location_note: Two bulldozer trenches perpendicular to the western Old City wall, near the south-west corner and south of the Citadel; no map reference.
notes: Building remains and much Herodian pottery under the surface; aims stated (Hasmonean-Herodian wall, First Temple expansion). No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים: בדיקות ליד בורג' כברית (Jerusalem, checks by Burj Kabrit)
author: Y. Margovsky
location_note: Foot of Burj Kabrit, south of the southern Old City wall between the Dung Gate and Zion Gate; no map reference.
notes: Tower upper part Crusader or Mamluk; Herodian remains, walls and fresco fragments under the medieval floor. The period word for one aqueduct is garbled in the text layer ('ההררריאנית'); not read as a date (page image not checked).

features.subtype: several further aqueducts between the Turkish aqueduct and the city wall, being exposed
features.period: one 'probably' of a period whose name is unreadable in the text layer; the others undated
features.quote: נחשפות עתה מספר אמות מים נוספות

title: ירושלים: הגבעה הצרפתית (Jerusalem, French Hill, Second Temple tombs)
author: E. Oren
location_note: French Hill near the Jerusalem-Ramallah road; no map reference.
notes: Tomb A: vaulted entrance room and kokhim chamber, sealed kokhim, ossuaries (one with a stylised pyramid tomb); tomb B 13 m north (Herodian lamp); tomb C 30 m north (late Hasmonean finds).

features.subtype: three kokhim tombs (A-C) with ossuaries and a central pit
features.period: tomb A 1st century CE before the destruction of the Second Temple; tomb B Herodian lamp; tomb C end of the Hasmonean period
features.quote: יש לקבוע את תאריך הקבר למאה הא

author: P. Bar-Adon

features.subtype: many caves with clear signs of habitation: sooted ceilings, mats, a straw basket, sandals, parchment, food remains

features.quote: ברבות מן המערות נמצאו סימני חיים מובהקים

author: Y. Margovsky

notes: Farm building (officina) of the Hasmonean and Herodian periods, destroyed in the First Revolt, perhaps in 68; its courtyard installations (stone box and basin, kilns) are built, not rock-cut, and not coded. Quadriburgium fort from the last third of the 4th century CE to the Arab conquest; agricultural enclosure and terraces; Greek papyrus of the 5th-6th centuries CE. The spring name above the fort is garbled in the text layer.
